block.cbc_firepower_components.compact_c: Left shaft: place the cannon or autocannon here.
Side shafts: kinetic input for pitch.
Top/Bottom shaft: kinetic input for yaw.
Front face: redstone fire control; wrench front/back to swap.
Back face: redstone assembly control; wrench front/back to swap.
After assembly: item input is forwarded to the mounted cannon.
block.cbc_firepower_components.compact_a: A light side-mounted turret for autocannons.
Left shaft: place an autocannon or handle autocannon here.
Side shafts: kinetic input for pitch.
Top/Bottom shaft: kinetic input for yaw.
Front face: redstone fire control; wrench front/back to swap.
Back face: redstone assembly control; wrench front/back to swap.
After assembly: item input feeds the mounted autocannon.
block.cbc_firepower_components.vertical_: A two-block universal cannon mount with twin trunnion supports.
Above or below the mount: place a cannon and power assembly.
Side shafts: kinetic input for pitch.
Shaft toward the cannon: kinetic input for yaw.
Front face: redstone fire control; wrench front/back to swap.
Back face: redstone assembly control; wrench front/back to swap.
After assembly: arms and item input feed the mounted cannon.
block.cbc_firepower_components.autocanno: Mixes main and tracer rounds at a configured interval for adjacent compact mounts.
Right-click to open CBC's ammo configuration screen with 64 main and 64 matching tracer rounds.
Accepts hopper, funnel, and arm input, then feeds assembled adjacent mounts using the tracer interval.
block.cbc_firepower_components.large_aut: Stores up to 64 main rounds and 64 matching tracer rounds.
Uses CBC autocannon ammo box behavior and accepts autocannon or machine gun rounds with tracer spacing.
Hoppers, funnels, and arms can insert main or tracer ammunition into the matching slot.
Dropped items keep stored ammo, tracers, and spacing settings.
block.cbc_firepower_components.cannon_ma: A three-round external magazine for assembled CBC big cannon mounts.
Automation inserts projectiles first, then powered big cartridges in matching columns.
Mechanical input waits for all three ammunition pairs before a loading cycle starts.
The sides, back, and bottom output spent empty big cartridges.
Manual insertion and removal are always allowed.
item.cbc_firepower_components.cannon_lim: Stores pitch and yaw limits on compact cannon mounts.

block.cbc_firepower_components.ready_amm: Stores complete rounds and selects the next ammunition type; 40-round capacity.
Accepts separate projectiles and propellant, plus self-contained CBC, CBCMS and CBCMW ammunition.
Empty-hand right-click opens the round box for manual ordering; sneak-right-click removes one selected round.
Feeds the selected type directly into an adjacent assembled mount first; the three-round loader is only an optional buffer.
Automation exposes separate ammunition and propellant slots; output is projectile then matching propellant, or one self-contained round.
No complete round of the selected type.
block.cbc_firepower_components.spent_cas: Collects dropped empty casings within 6 blocks horizontally and 3 blocks vertically.
Recognizes CBC, CBCMS and CBCMW casings, stores four stacks, and never pulls from adjacent inventories.
Outputs to automation on every side; empty-hand right-click removes one casing.
Recovered items remain unchanged for player-built reloading lines.
block.cbc_firepower_components.automatic: Converts ordinary redstone input into automatic firing sequences for the mount.
Tap empty-hand right-click to fire; hold to open a mode screen and explicitly choose firing rhythm and polling/salvo coordination.
Base operation controls adjacent mounts and ready racks; Drive By Wire is only an optional upgrade that adds remote bound targets.
A rising edge from ordinary redstone or a Create Redstone Link receiver on the rear face equals one short right-click; other faces ignore commands.
Polling selects the next mount for each firing pulse, while salvo activates every mount together; sneak-right-click selects ammunition.
Controlled ready racks switched to the selected ammunition.
That ammunition is no longer present in the controlled ready racks.
No adjacent smart ammunition compartment found.
Tap/rear rising edge: fire; hold: open mode screen; sneak-right-click: select ammunition
screen.cbc_firepower_components.ready_am: Select two slots to swap; green is first
item.cbc_firepower_components.spyglass_r: Built-in optical ranging: press [R] while using the spyglass to measure actual straight-line distance (rebindable).
Unable to resolve actual distance across the current physical spaces
block.cbc_firepower_components.carousel_: A centered 3x3 low-profile carousel holding 24 ready ammunition sets.
Supply rotation from below; the selected round indexes to the outlet by the shortest path.
Place a mount above the center or against any outer edge; the rack adopts that direction as its outlet.
Every outer section accepts hand and mechanical-arm loading; empty-hand use opens the circular sorting screen.
Adjacent control and redstone remain standard; Drive By Wire only adds optional remote ammunition selection.
cbc_firepower_components.ponder.compact_: Compact mounts hold a cannon while occupying less room than a standard mounting
Place the supported cannon on the mounting side

The opposite signal faces assemble the cannon and fire it

cbc_firepower_components.ponder.vertical: This two-support mounting places the cannon directly above or below its base
The connecting trunnion remains horizontal between the supports
In its default orientation, the cannon is installed above the mount
Rotate the mount vertically when the cannon must hang below it
cbc_firepower_components.ponder.single_l: Begin with the large autocannon breech
Continue the connected barrel in one straight line
A muzzle brake reduces recoil and shortens the visible rearward travel
Feed armor-piercing or high-explosive rounds into the breech

cbc_firepower_components.ponder.autocann: Large autocannon ammunition boxes hold loose autocannon rounds
Point the feed path from the box toward the breech
Armor-piercing and high-explosive rounds can share the same feed system

Then insert the matching propellant charge

cbc_firepower_components.ponder.carousel: The carousel occupies a centered 3 by 3 footprint and stores 24 complete rounds

cbc_firepower_components.ponder.automati: A short right-click sends one firing command
Hold right-click to open the Create-style mode selector
Choose single fire, three-round burst or continuous fire in one section
Choose polling or salvo separately; polling advances between mounts, while salvo triggers all
Sneak-right-click selects the next ammunition type

Bind mounts and ready ammunition equipment without assigning different jobs to different signal faces
